name: ACFun
notes: Stable-derived Local-First delivery pilot. Business baseline is the device-proven Stable 0.4.9 / Build149 eight-module runtime; Alpha11 playback/auth_key and comic-reader research is not merged and remains preserved in candidate.json. First launch installs immutable Entry/Builder, fetches the frozen Stable modules plus final local overlay, and generates one local runtime bundle plus the existing image decoder. Normal later startup uses local Entry + one require(file://) runtime bundle. Historical acfun_core_src_v018/v019 compatibility slots now trampoline to $.require('acfun'), so play/favorite/diagnostic lazyRule actions re-enter the full current local runtime instead of the old base Core or Remote Bootstrap. Stable/Latest/Web remain unchanged until device validation.
